# API reference

All JSON responses: `{ "ok": true, "data": ... }` or `{ "ok": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`.
Status codes: 200/201 success, 401 not logged in, 403 forbidden/CSRF/blocked, 404 not found (also used for other users' orders), 409 conflict/invalid transition, 422 validation, 429 rate limited, 500/502/503.

Writes require a same-origin `Origin` header (CSRF protection) and are validated with Zod. Admin endpoints check permissions server-side on every call.

## Auth
| Method | Path | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/auth/discord?returnTo=/checkout/vip` | Starts OAuth (state + PKCE in signed HTTP-only cookie) |
| GET | `/api/auth/discord/callback` | Validates state, syncs user, bootstraps admins, sets session |
| POST | `/api/auth/logout` | Destroys session |
| GET | `/api/auth/session` | Current user or `{ authenticated: false }` |

## Storefront (public)
| GET | `/api/store` | Branding, homepage, server, community, legal, announcements, server status |
| GET | `/api/categories` | Active categories |
| GET | `/api/products?type=RANK&category=slug&featured=true` | Active products |
| GET | `/api/products/[slug]` | Product detail |
| GET | `/api/server-status` | Cached Minecraft status (never throws) |
| GET | `/api/media/public/...` | Public media for the local storage driver |
| GET | `/api/health` | DB health check |

## Orders (logged-in customer, own orders only)
| GET | `/api/orders` | Order history |
| POST | `/api/orders` | `{ productSlug, purchaseType, gameEdition, minecraftUsername, giftNote?, idempotencyKey }` → `{ orderNumber, created }` |
| GET | `/api/orders/[orderNumber]` | Order, items, screenshots, timeline |
| GET | `/api/orders/[orderNumber]/payment` | UPI ID, amount, intent URI, QR data URL, status, expiry |
| POST | `/api/orders/[orderNumber]/screenshot` | multipart `file` (+ optional `transactionRef`) → VERIFYING |
| GET | `/api/orders/[orderNumber]/screenshot/[id]` | Private image (owner or admin) |

## Admin
| Method | Path | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/admin/dashboard` | dashboard.view |
| GET, POST | `/api/admin/products` | products.manage |
| GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | `/api/admin/products/[id]` | products.manage (PATCH = quick toggles) |
| POST | `/api/admin/products/[id]/duplicate` | products.manage |
| POST | `/api/admin/products/reorder` `{ ids }` | products.manage |
| GET, POST | `/api/admin/categories`; PATCH, DELETE `/[id]` | categories.manage |
| GET | `/api/admin/orders?q&discord&mc&product&from&to&purchaseType&edition&payment&fulfillment&page` | orders.view |
| GET, PATCH | `/api/admin/orders/[id]` | PATCH `{ action }`: confirm_payment, reject_payment, request_evidence (payments.verify) · start_fulfillment, mark_fulfilled, mark_failed (fulfillment.manage) · cancel (orders.cancel) · refund (payments.refund) · add_note (orders.note) |
| GET | `/api/admin/payments?status&q&page` | payments.view |
| POST | `/api/admin/payments/poll` | payments.verify |
| PATCH | `/api/admin/payments/emails/[id]` `{ action: "link", orderNumber }` or `{ action: "ignore", reason }` | payments.verify |
| PATCH | `/api/admin/payments/screenshots/[id]` `{ decision: "APPROVE", transactionRef? }` or `{ decision: "REJECT", reason }` | payments.verify |
| GET | `/api/admin/users?q&status&page`; GET, PATCH `/[id]` `{ action: block/unblock }` | users.view / users.block |
| GET, POST | `/api/admin/admins`; PATCH `/[id]` | admins.manage |
| GET | `/api/admin/fulfillment?status=FULFILLED` | fulfillment.manage |
| GET, PUT | `/api/admin/settings` `{ section, value }` | storefront.manage; payment/imap need settings.payment |
| POST | `/api/admin/settings/test-imap` | settings.payment |
| GET, POST | `/api/admin/media`; DELETE `/[id]` | media.manage |
| GET, POST | `/api/admin/announcements`; PATCH, DELETE `/[id]` | storefront.manage |
| GET | `/api/admin/audit-logs?action&entity&page` | audit.view |

Role matrix lives in `src/lib/permissions/index.ts`.

# Deployment, admin setup and payment worker setup

## 1. Discord application
1. https://discord.com/developers/applications → New Application.
2. OAuth2 → copy **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
3. OAuth2 → Redirects → add `https://YOUR_DOMAIN/api/auth/discord/callback` (must match `DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI` exactly).
Only the `identify` scope is used.

## 2. VPS deployment (Docker Compose)
Requirements: Docker + Compose plugin, a domain pointing at the VPS, ~2 GB RAM (the Next.js build is memory hungry).

```bash
git clone <repo> jpxmc && cd jpxmc     # or upload and unzip the files
cp .env.example .env && nano .env      # fill in every value
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose logs -f migrate web worker
```
Services: `postgres`, `redis`, `migrate` (runs migrations + seed, then exits), `web` (port 3000 on 127.0.0.1), `worker`.

### HTTPS reverse proxy (Caddy example)
```
jpxsmpstore.vercel.app {
  reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:3000
}
```
Nginx works too; forward `X-Forwarded-For` and `Host`. Cookies are `Secure` in production, so HTTPS is required.

### Updating
```bash
git pull && docker compose up -d --build   # migrate runs again automatically
```

### Backups
`docker compose exec postgres pg_dump -U jpxmc jpxmc > backup.sql` (schedule with cron). Also back up the `storage` volume if you use `STORAGE_DRIVER=local`.

## 3. Admin setup
1. Put your Discord user ID in `ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS` (comma-separated). Get it from Discord: Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode, then right-click your name → Copy User ID.
2. Log in on the store. You are created as **SUPER_ADMIN** and the action is audit-logged.
3. Go to `/admin/dashboard`.
4. **Settings → UPI payments:** UPI ID, payee name, instructions, expiry. Checkout stays disabled until a UPI ID is set and QR payments are enabled.
5. **Storefront:** name, logo, hero, server IP, Discord invite, announcements, footer, terms and privacy.
6. **Categories / Products:** add the real JPXMC catalog. The seed deliberately creates no products or prices.
7. **Settings → Admin roles:** add staff by Discord ID as ADMIN or SUPPORT. Removing someone from `ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS` does not revoke access; revoke in the admin panel.

## 4. Payment worker (IMAP) setup
The worker polls a mailbox that receives your bank's or UPI app's **credit alert** emails.

1. Use a dedicated mailbox, or forward bank alerts to one. For Gmail, enable IMAP and create an **App Password** (requires 2FA). Host `imap.gmail.com`, port 993, TLS on.
2. Admin → Settings → Email verification (IMAP): enter host, port, username, password, mailbox (e.g. `INBOX`), polling interval.
3. Add **trusted senders**, one per line: the exact address your bank uses (e.g. `alerts@hdfcbank.net`) or a domain (`@hdfcbank.net`). Emails from any other sender are recorded as UNTRUSTED and never used. Emails whose `Authentication-Results` show a DKIM/SPF/DMARC failure are also rejected.
4. Click **Test connection**, then enable and save.
5. Check Admin → Payments: worker status should show Online with a recent poll.

### How matching works
- Parsers (`worker/src/parsers`) handle HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis, Kotak, Paytm, PhonePe and GPay Business senders, plus a generic UPI-credit fallback. Debit alerts are ignored. To add a provider, add a parser to the `PARSERS` list.
- **High confidence:** the email contains the order number (customers' UPI note is pre-filled with it), the exact amount, a UTR, and a time inside the payment window ± tolerance. If "auto-confirm" is on, the order becomes PAID and enters the fulfillment queue.
- **Medium confidence:** exactly one open order has that exact amount. The order becomes MATCHED and waits for an admin to confirm.
- **AMBIGUOUS / UNMATCHED / DUPLICATE / PARSE_FAILED / UNTRUSTED** results are logged in Admin → Payments for manual linking or ignoring. Nothing is ever confirmed on a guess.
- Idempotency: Message-ID is unique, UTR is unique, the order row is locked during updates, and failed polls retry with exponential backoff.
- The last processed IMAP UID is kept in Redis, so the worker never re-reads old mail; the first run looks back 2 days.
- Unpaid PENDING orders expire automatically (every minute). Orders with a screenshot (VERIFYING) wait for an admin.

### Screenshot fallback
Customers can upload PNG/JPG/WebP proof (size and count limits in Settings). Files are validated by magic bytes and stored privately. Approving a screenshot in the order page or Payments page is the only way it leads to PAID.

## 5. Storage
- `STORAGE_DRIVER=local` (default): files go to the `storage` Docker volume. Public images are served from `/api/media/public/...`; screenshots are never publicly reachable.
- `STORAGE_DRIVER=cloudinary`: set `CLOUDINARY_*`. Public images use normal delivery; screenshots use `authenticated` assets streamed through the app.

## 6. Testing
`npm test` runs parser, matching, validation, money, UPI and permission tests against mock bank-email fixtures (`tests/fixtures/emails.ts`). No real transfers are needed. Before going live, do one real end-to-end run: create a ₹1 test product, buy it, pay it, confirm the worker matches it, fulfil it, then deactivate the product.

# Database schema

PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM. Source: `src/db/schema/`. Migration: `src/db/migrations/0000_init.sql`. All money columns are **integer paise**. All timestamps are `timestamptz`.

## Enums
`account_status` (ACTIVE, BLOCKED) · `admin_role` (SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, SUPPORT) · `product_type` (RANK, CRATE, COINS, CUSTOM) · `purchase_type` (SELF, GIFT) · `game_edition` (JAVA, BEDROCK) · `payment_status` (PENDING, VERIFYING, MATCHED, PAID, REJECTED, EXPIRED, REFUNDED) · `fulfillment_status` (PENDING, PROCESSING, FULFILLED, FAILED, CANCELLED) · `payment_method` (UPI_EMAIL, UPI_SCREENSHOT, MANUAL) · `payment_email_status` (MATCHED, UNMATCHED, AMBIGUOUS, DUPLICATE, UNTRUSTED, PARSE_FAILED, IGNORED) · `screenshot_status` · `history_kind` · `actor_type` · `fulfillment_method` (MANUAL, RCON, PLUGIN) · `announcement_type`.

## Tables

| Table | Purpose | Key constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `users` | Discord users (everyone who logs in) | `discord_id` UNIQUE |
| `sessions` | Server-side sessions; id = HMAC(cookie token) | FK users ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `admin_users` | Admin roles by Discord ID (can exist before first login) | `discord_id` UNIQUE, FK users SET NULL |
| `categories` | Product groups, soft delete | `slug` UNIQUE |
| `products` | Catalog; type-specific data in `metadata` JSONB validated by Zod | `slug` UNIQUE, FK categories SET NULL, soft delete |
| `product_images` | Gallery images | FK products CASCADE |
| `media_assets` | Media library (public images) | soft delete |
| `orders` | One purchase; separate `payment_status` and `fulfillment_status` | `order_number` UNIQUE, (`user_id`,`idempotency_key`) UNIQUE, FK users RESTRICT |
| `order_items` | Price + product **snapshot** | FK orders CASCADE, FK products SET NULL |
| `payments` | UPI request + verification evidence (1 per order) | `order_id` UNIQUE, `transaction_ref` UNIQUE (NULLs allowed) |
| `payment_emails` | Every processed IMAP email with parse + match result | `message_id` UNIQUE |
| `payment_screenshots` | Private screenshot uploads + review | FK orders CASCADE |
| `fulfillments` | Delivery record: username, edition, product, admin Discord ID, time, notes, proof | `order_id` UNIQUE |
| `order_status_history` | Every status change, event and internal note | FK orders CASCADE |
| `store_settings` | Key/value JSONB settings (branding, homepage, server, community, legal, payment, imap) | PK key |
| `announcements` | Homepage announcements with schedule, soft delete | |
| `audit_logs` | Append-only audit trail | indexes on time, entity, actor |

## Relationships
`users 1─* orders 1─* order_items`, `orders 1─1 payments`, `orders 1─1 fulfillments`, `orders 1─* payment_screenshots`, `orders 1─* order_status_history`, `orders 1─* payment_emails (matched)`, `categories 1─* products 1─* product_images`.

## Delete policies
Orders and payments use RESTRICT so financial records can't be lost by deleting a user or order. Products and categories are soft-deleted (`deleted_at`) and their slug is renamed so it can be reused; order snapshots stay intact.

## Payment status transitions
```
PENDING   → VERIFYING, MATCHED, PAID, REJECTED, EXPIRED
VERIFYING → PENDING, MATCHED, PAID, REJECTED, EXPIRED
MATCHED   → PAID, REJECTED, VERIFYING
REJECTED  → VERIFYING, PAID
EXPIRED   → VERIFYING, MATCHED, PAID   (late payment found)
PAID      → REFUNDED
```
Fulfillment: `PENDING → PROCESSING/FULFILLED/FAILED/CANCELLED`, `PROCESSING → FULFILLED/FAILED/CANCELLED/PENDING`, `FAILED → PROCESSING/CANCELLED`. Fulfillment requires payment PAID.

## Changing the schema
Edit `src/db/schema/*.ts`, run `npm run db:generate -- --name <change>`, commit the SQL, deploy (the `migrate` service applies it).

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-jpxmc}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [REDACTED] POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-jpxmc}
    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-jpxmc}"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes"]
    volumes: [redisdata:/data]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20

  migrate:
    build: { context: ., target: worker }
    env_file: .env
    command: ["sh", "-c", "npx tsx scripts/migrate.ts && npx tsx scripts/seed.ts"]
    depends_on:
      postgres: { condition: service_healthy }
    restart: "no"

  web:
    build: { context: ., target: web }
    env_file: .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:3000:3000"]   # put Nginx/Caddy in front for HTTPS
    volumes: [storage:/app/storage]
    depends_on:
      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }
      redis: { condition: service_healthy }
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      retries: 3

  worker:
    build: { context: ., target: worker }
    env_file: .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes: [storage:/app/storage]
    depends_on:
      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }
      redis: { condition: service_healthy }

volumes:
  pgdata:
  redisdata:
  storage:
